pipelines.name: Cleanup After Release

steps.name: Configure Git
steps.run:
git config user.name "Saleor Deployments"
git config user.email "deployments@saleor.io"

steps.name: Check if merged PR was from changeset-release
steps.run:
# Get the commit message to check if it's from changeset-release branch
if echo "$COMMIT_MSG" | grep -q "Release.*\[automated\]"; then
  echo "is_release_merge=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "✅ This is a release PR merge from changeset-release/$CURRENT_RELEASE"
else
  echo "is_release_merge=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "ℹ️  This is not a release PR merge, skipping cleanup PR creation"
fi

steps.name: Create cleanup PR
steps.run:
# Fetch latest changes
git fetch origin

echo "Creating new cleanup PR from $CURRENT_RELEASE to main"

gh pr create \
  --base=main \
  --head="$CURRENT_RELEASE" \
  --title="Clean up after release $VERSION" \
  --body="$(cat <<EOF
This PR syncs changes from the release branch back to main after a release.

- Release branch: $CURRENT_RELEASE
- Version: $VERSION

Please review and merge to keep main up to date with the latest release changes.
EOF
)"

pipelines.name: Create Draft Release

steps.name: Extract changelog for version
Get previous tag
steps.run:
CURRENT_TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"

# Get all tags sorted by version, find the one before current
PREV_TAG=$(git tag --sort=-version:refname | grep -A1 "^${CURRENT_TAG}$" | tail -n1)

if [ -z "$PREV_TAG" ] || [ "$PREV_TAG" = "$CURRENT_TAG" ]; then
  echo "No previous tag found"
  echo "has_prev_tag=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
else
  echo "Previous tag: $PREV_TAG"
  echo "prev_tag=$PREV_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "has_prev_tag=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
fi

steps.name: Create release body
steps.run:
CURRENT_TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
CHANGELOG=$(cat /tmp/changelog.txt)

# Start building the release body
{
  echo "$CHANGELOG"
  echo ""

  # Add diff link if we have a previous tag
  if [[ "${HAS_PREV_TAG}" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/$REPO/compare/${PREV_TAG}...${CURRENT_TAG}"
  fi
} > /tmp/release_body.txt

# Base64 encoded to avoid errors "Unable to process file command 'output'"
echo "b64_release_body=$(base64 -w0 /tmp/release_body.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Create draft release
steps.run:
CURRENT_TAG="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
body=$(base64 -d <<< "$B64_RELEASE_BODY")

gh release create "$CURRENT_TAG" \
  --draft \
  --title="$CURRENT_TAG" \
  --notes="$body"

echo "✅ Draft release created for $CURRENT_TAG"

with.custom_title: 🚨 Draft Release Creation Failed for *${{ github.ref_name }}*

steps.name: Recreate current release branch
steps.run:
CURRENT_RELEASE='3.23'

echo "Recreating release branch: $CURRENT_RELEASE"

# Fetch all branches
git fetch origin

# Switch to main branch
git checkout main
git pull origin main

# Delete the old release branch locally if it exists
if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/$CURRENT_RELEASE; then
  echo "Deleting local branch $CURRENT_RELEASE"
  git branch -D "$CURRENT_RELEASE"
fi

# Delete the remote release branch if it exists
if git ls-remote --heads origin $CURRENT_RELEASE | grep -q $CURRENT_RELEASE; then
  echo "Deleting remote branch $CURRENT_RELEASE"
  git push origin --delete "refs/heads/$CURRENT_RELEASE"
fi

# Create new branch from main
echo "Creating new branch $CURRENT_RELEASE from main"
git checkout -b "$CURRENT_RELEASE"

# Push the new branch
echo "Pushing new branch $CURRENT_RELEASE to remote"
git push origin "refs/heads/$CURRENT_RELEASE:refs/heads/$CURRENT_RELEASE"

echo "✅ Successfully recreated release branch $CURRENT_RELEASE from main"

steps.name: Generate shard matrix
steps.run:
MAX_CONCURRENCY=4
if [ "$CONCURRENCY" -gt "$MAX_CONCURRENCY" ]; then
  echo "[WARN] The requested number of shards ($CONCURRENCY) exceeds maximum allowed value ($MAX_CONCURRENCY). Using $MAX_CONCURRENCY shards instead." >&2
  CONCURRENCY=$MAX_CONCURRENCY
fi
shard_matrix=()                             # Initialize an empty array to store the shard values.
for i in $(seq 1 "$CONCURRENCY"); do        # Loop through the numbers from 1 to $CONCURRENCY.
  shard_matrix+=("\"$i/$CONCURRENCY\"")     # For each number i, append a string in the format "${i}/${CONCURRENCY}" to the shard_matrix array.
done
shard_matrix=( $(IFS=,; echo "[${shard_matrix[*]}]") ) # Join the elements of the shard_matrix array with commas and wrap the result in square brackets to create a valid JSON array string.
echo "SHARD_MATRIX=${shard_matrix[0]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Check if tag should be tagged as "latest"
steps.run:
set -ux

# Only stable semver releases (e.g. 3.22.0) can be tagged as latest.
# Non-semver refs (branch names, PR refs) are not valid candidates to become latest.
if ! [[ "$CURRENT_TAG" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "Tag inferred from this run ('$CURRENT_TAG') is not a semver release - can't be tagged as latest."
  echo "IS_LATEST=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  exit 0
fi

CURRENT_LATEST=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/latest" --jq .tag_name)
HIGHEST=$( (echo "$CURRENT_LATEST"; echo "$CURRENT_TAG") | sort -V | tail -1)

echo "Selected: $CURRENT_TAG, Latest: $CURRENT_LATEST"

if [[ "$CURRENT_TAG" == "$HIGHEST" ]]; then
  echo "IS_LATEST=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
else
  echo "IS_LATEST=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
fi
